items.name: Lagoon creature Valentine
items.description: A green lagoon creature reaches forward inside a blue heart, above the words WE’D MAKE A SPLASH TOGETHER! on a cream Valentine card.
items.note: I can't remember exactly what character this is but it's like the swamp monster, the classic Halloween lagoon creature. I really like this old Halloween aesthetic with Frankenstein and the swamp monster. These old sci-fi movies are really cool to me.

items.name: Starlit blue The End
items.description: Sparkling white script spelling The End glows across a deep blue background scattered with tiny stars.
items.note: This is one of my favorite images in the world. I love this blue color with tiny tiny stars in it, with the end script as well, like it's usually with Disney and "The End." I just love that night sky with that deep blue.

items.name: Hot pink Desire
items.description: A vivid hot pink rectangular color pan in a dark case has the word DESIRE printed beneath it.
items.note: I love this color, hot pink. I find hot pink all the time in things that I like. I usually find it not in a Barbie way. In the old Disney title cards it was used as a highlight color or Venus flytraps have this color sometimes.

items.name: Daft Punk bathroom graffiti
items.description: Black handwritten lettering on a bathroom stall door reads Daft Punk is Playing at My House.
items.note: I love Daft Punk. This is like a bar bathroom with Sharpie writing, which in itself is an aesthetic but the writing is about Daft Punk, which is cool too.

items.name: Thrill of a Romance curtains
items.description: Large white title lettering stands in front of rich red theater curtains, with flowers and decorative birds along the bottom.
items.note: This is another title card that I like. One thing I like about title cards is the fonts but this one also has those grand theater bright red curtains, which is gorgeous. I love that romantic theater vibe.

items.name: Space, the final frontier
items.description: Tiny white stars fill a black sky above a yellow caption reading SPACE, THE FINAL FRONTIER.
items.note: This is a scene from Star Trek. It's just the night sky with stars and the yellow text at the bottom that says "Space, the Final Frontier."

items.name: Sword and cigarette
items.description: A first-person street photograph shows one hand holding a cigarette and the other holding a long sword, with dark sleeves and fingerless gloves.
items.note: A girl holding a cigarette in her left hand and a sword in her right hand. I love this modern knight aesthetic.

items.name: The cow that jumped over the moon
items.description: A cow jumps beside a yellow crescent moon over a golden castle, with tiny stars and a tall beanstalk against black.
items.note: This is the land of make-believe. I remember this from my childhood and I don't even know how but it's been such a big part of the way I view my own thoughts and aesthetics and vibes. This whole taste board is literally the land of make-believe.

items.name: Bread-and-butterflies
items.description: Small animated creatures with bread-slice wings and yellow butter markings flutter among dark green leaves.
items.note: The bread and butterflies from Alice in Wonderland are one of my favorite little niche side characters. I just love the imagination and the look of them.

items.name: Humpty Dumpty in Make-Believe
items.description: A small egg-shaped character in a purple hat sits on a gray wall beside a green hillside and a handwritten Humpty-Dumpty label.
items.note: Another picture of the land of make-believe. This is Humpty Dumpty.

items.name: The Emerald City and Moo-Moo Bird
items.description: A multicolored long-tailed bird flies beside the pointed towers of the Emerald City of Oz above mountains on an illustrated map.
items.note: Another picture of the land of make-believe.

items.name: Castles and winding paths
items.description: Red-roofed castles, stone bridges and winding paths cross steep green and brown cliffs above blue water beneath a starry black sky.
items.note: Another picture of the land of make-believe.

items.name: Nervous knight with hearts
items.description: A hand-drawn knight holds a long sword close to its body, with drooping heart-tipped stems on the helmet against a vivid red background.
items.note: Okay this is a knight that looks kind of nervous and has these little hearts drooping off of his hat. For some reason I have this thing with the archetype of a nervous knight. He is always in everything I think of. This also has that romantic Valentine's Day look that I love, with the white and the black and the hand-drawn checkered and hearts.

items.name: White tree with bright ornaments
items.description: A white Christmas tree sparkles with pink, red, blue and yellow ornaments in a dark green illustrated room.
items.note: This is a Christmas image of a white Christmas tree and ornaments. Now when I like Christmas, I love the early 2000s nostalgic Christmas with the pink and the orange and the lights. However I also love this aesthetic for Christmas, which is very kitschy and colorful and bright.

items.name: Black cats and a curved Christmas tree
items.description: Stylized black cats with pale blue eyes sit on presents and a sweeping green Christmas tree decorated with pink ornaments.
items.note: This is a little Christmas drawing of some cats but I specifically like the cats in this because they remind me of French Kitty or that little Space Kitty. I love that cat.

items.name: Disney Christmas greetings
items.description: Mickey decorates a Christmas tree beside Donald, while Peter Pan and flying children appear within pink curtains against a blue night sky.
items.note: This is a little Christmas graphic from Disney with Peter Pan, Mickey, and Donald. I love this because it specifically reminds me of the old Mickey Mouse books I would read at my great-grandmother's house. I again love this hand-drawn style that is always very childlike and related to storybooks and Disney.

items.name: Dragon Tales star pattern
items.description: Colorful cartoon dragons repeat across a purple background dotted with small yellow, pink and white stars.
items.note: This is a Dragon Tales pattern. It kind of looks like an '80s arcade but I just love Dragon Tales.

items.name: Iridescent glitter makeup
items.description: A close-up of eyes, eyebrows and cheeks covered in reflective silver, lavender and gold glitter.
items.note: I love glitter and I especially love Euphoria's aesthetic when it comes to makeup.

items.name: Candyland character cards
items.description: Six illustrated game cards pair bright sweets with colorful characters on small pink squares.
items.note: These are the Candyland cards. I really like nostalgia when it comes to my taste but I like those very niche or underrated parts of nostalgia that you have a hard time remembering.

items.name: Queen of Hearts concept study
items.description: A stylized queen wears a colorful geometric dress and tall crown, holding a pink heart-shaped scepter and pointing to the right on cream paper.
items.note: I'm pretty sure this is the original concept artwork for the Queen of Hearts by Mary Blair. I absolutely love Mary Blair and her artwork.

items.name: Be merry and bright
items.description: A green Christmas tree in sunglasses plays a keyboard beside a small walking cup, surrounded by stars on a red background.
items.note: This is like a nostalgic Christmas graphic that has the same artwork as the movie theater commercials where the soda pop walks around. I also love the red and green together. I found I love red and green together.

items.name: Lilly on a bicycle
items.description: A watercolor-and-ink mouse wearing dark heart-shaped sunglasses and purple overalls rides a bicycle; a small orange animal sits in the front basket, with green foliage and autumn leaves behind.
items.note: This is Lily in the purple plastic purse. I love these old childhood books as inspiration. Especially this one was really important to me.

items.name: Mermaid cat with a martini
items.description: A long, angular black cat with a turquoise mermaid tail drapes over an oversized martini glass, holding a tiny pink cocktail. Pale chartreuse background, delicate black linework, a coral fish and olive below.
items.note: Another look: French kitty-looking image. I like how this one has the little martini. It's kind of weird it's got the fish tail, the mermaid tail but I like the cats like this with their little cocktail.

items.name: Gonzo as the Tin Man
items.description: Photograph of a warmly weathered metallic Gonzo with funnel hat, curved nose, rivets, jointed limbs and rectangular opening in his chest against soft green foliage.
items.note: This is Gonzo as the Tin Man from The Wizard of Oz. I really like The Wizard of Oz and I like how it symbolizes something deep and meaningful. It's still really weird and wacky and I like how the Muppets are here too.

items.name: Ruby slippers
items.description: A film still cropped to Dorothy's sparkling red shoes, pale blue socks and blue gingham skirt, with a sparkling star wand at the right.
items.note: These are the red slippers from The Wizard of Oz. I've always loved this iconic symbol just because it's iconic and also I find it really interesting how it represents the Industrial Revolution and all that. In the book it was silver and for these they're red, all just like the lore behind it. I find lore behind movies when they're so deep in detail because then you have all the different deaths and the illness that comes with being in these movies and you have all those stories.

items.name: The Big Screen
items.description: A black-and-white cinematic graphic with large diagonally stacked, dimensional block lettering reading The Big Screen; small handwritten script above, theater facade photograph behind, compact credits below.
items.note: This is an old black-and-white title screen, title slide, whatever. I really like it.

items.name: Lily pads
items.description: A close photograph of overlapping round, notched green lily pads on dark rippling pond water, centered on one small white water-lily blossom.
items.note: Lily pads. I'm really inspired by frogs. I love frogs so, so much and with that I love lily pads and ponds. But lily pads specifically are just so gorgeous and peaceful to me, and my favorite color ever

items.name: Pooh and friends on a bridge
items.description: Soft pastel-and-ink storybook illustration of Winnie the Pooh, Eeyore, Piglet and Tigger crossing a stone arch bridge, carrying toy-like accessories beneath drifting leaves; pale blue, cream, peach and green palette.
items.note: Old Winnie the Pooh. This was my childhood baby bedroom theme and I love it. I love old Winnie the Pooh illustrations. It's so soft.

items.name: Narnia lamppost
items.description: Tall film still of a small girl in a brown coat looking up at a dark lamppost among densely snow-covered trees. Muted mauve-gray winter light makes the lamppost silhouette stand out.
items.note: This is a scene from Narnia. It's when Lucy sees the lamppost for the first time in the woods and I just don't know why this is such a specific scene to me. I could remember it like the back of my hand. I remember watching the behind-the-scenes of it when I was a child and it just really stuck out to me because this character is in this real-world set for the first time. It's genuine emotion as they record her being in this immersive set.

items.name: Disco laundry
items.description: Sparse fashion-style ink illustration on white: two long-legged women in black clothing sit on a washing machine and hold stemmed glasses beneath a small disco ball; a laundry basket sits below.
items.note: This is a little 2D illustration of two girls talking over a washer under a disco ball. I really love this type of drawing. It's lowkey bad but I've always been drawn to it and did it a lot in my art class. It's really cute.

items.name: Peanuts Christmas
items.description: Flat outlined cartoon of Charlie Brown and Snoopy on a bright red armchair beside a fireplace and hanging stockings; yellow Woodstock birds line the foreground, with teal wall and red-green accents.
items.note: This is the Charlie Brown Christmas episode. We watch this every year. Every Thanksgiving, Halloween, and Christmas we watch the Charlie Brown specials. It's a family tradition and so they're really important to me. I'm really drawn to them.

discovery.via: Watching Peanuts is a family holiday tradition

items.name: Psychedelic Christmas
items.description: A couple in bell-bottom trousers decorates a green Christmas tree against hot-pink and orange stripes. Floral border, paisley stocking, green-red ornaments, checkered trousers and tall curving white The Two of Us lettering create a dense graphic composition.
items.note: This is a little Christmas illustration that is so fucking cute. It has a pink and red background with bright-ass colors. I love the color scheme. I don't know what this aesthetic is so I need you to figure that out.

items.name: Dancing among the stars
items.description: A stylized couple dances within a deep-blue night sky full of scattered white starbursts and tiny dots. The woman's full skirt is vivid pink with pale blue and white shapes; the dark-clad partner nearly blends into the sky.
items.note: I'm pretty sure this is Cinderella concept art, which I also really love. I think it's by Mary Blair as well but I love the blue and the pink and the white here.

items.name: Wonderland flower garden
items.description: Tiny Alice stands beneath an enormous, densely layered garden of character-like flowers and curling leaves. Flat orange, pink, pale blue and yellow blossoms against dark blue-green, with luminous yellow-green grass below.
items.note: This is Mary Blair concept art of Alice in Wonderland, but specifically the flower scene. The flowers are one of my favorite characters in Alice in Wonderland. They're gorgeous and they can sing amazingly. It's just truly Alice in Wonderland to me.

items.name: Celestial-cloak wizard
items.description: Bold black-and-white line illustration of a long-bearded wizard in a pointed star hat and a cloak covered in a huge radiant sun, crescent moon and white stars, holding a tripod-mounted telescope.
items.note: This is a little black-and-white illustration of a wizard with a cloak with the sun, moon, and stars on it, and a little hat with the stars on it. I just love wizards like this. I love their cloak and their hat with the stars.

items.name: Wizard with a telescope
items.description: Black ink wizard with long hair, pointed star-and-moon hat and celestial cloak peers through a handheld telescope across an aged cream background; thin radiant suns and comet-like streaks surround him.
items.note: Another wizard

items.name: Medieval spell lettering
items.description: A parchment-like illuminated page with deep-blue blackletter text, a large decorated initial, gold outlines and curling gold flourishes, reading a spell about waking from slumber through true love's kiss.
items.note: I'm pretty sure this is text from Sleeping Beauty, the movie. I love it. I love this medieval calligraphy with the gold. It's gorgeous.

discovery.via: Gold lettering and the medieval storybook look

items.name: Wonderland sun and moon
items.description: Two expressive circular faces in a film still: a warm yellow sun against muted clouds at left and a pale blue moon against dark blue night and small blue stars at right.
items.note: The Moon and the Sun from Alice in Wonderland. They had a small song in the movie.

items.name: Tomorrowland: Rocket to the Moon
items.description: Tall retro-style attraction poster with an upright white rocket, red stripes, a domed building and tiny visitors beneath a dark starry blue sky. Narrow white lettering reads Rocket to the Moon, with Tomorrowland below.
items.note: This is a little space illustration for Tomorrowland. I love the aesthetic of Tomorrowland so fucking much.

items.name: Halloween tree — The New Yorker
items.description: A muted ochre-and-olive magazine cover with a huge pale moon, bare tree holding stylized cats and owls, and a smiling pumpkin at the base. Yellow The New Yorker lettering runs across the top.
items.note: This is a New Yorker cover for Halloween. I love so many of the New Yorker covers but I specifically love the ones for holidays. These, the Christmas and Halloween ones, always eat.

items.name: Dancing robots and records
items.description: Three playful blocky robots dance in red rectangular panels on a white background, with a red record player, loose vinyl records, musical notes, stars and spirals. Sparse black and white details create a strong red graphic palette.
items.note: This is a little 50s robot illustration. I love the vinyls, the music, the characters, and the bright red color.

items.name: Muppets in a monster laboratory
items.description: Miss Piggy wears a white gown and cape with a huge Bride-of-Frankenstein-style hairdo; Kermit appears in dark monster costume behind her amid wires, glass laboratory apparatus and a dim blue-lit stone set.
items.note: This is the Muppets, but for Halloween they were the Mad Scientist and the Bride of Frankenstein I think. Super cute with the Mad Scientist theme, Halloween, and the Muppets.

items.name: Kermit with a banjo
items.description: Kermit sits on a fallen mossy tree above still swamp water, holding a pale banjo, surrounded by drooping greenery, branches and soft natural light.
items.note: Kermit singing with the banjo, classic.

items.name: Cinderella’s sparkling carriage
items.description: A stylized pink pumpkin carriage with white curled wheels stands amid turquoise plants, silhouetted black trees and starbursts. Pale pink and blue figures surround it, with swirls of white and pink magic above.
items.note: Mary Blair concept art for Cinderella. The blue and the pink are gorgeous. The sparkles, the magic: you can feel the magic and nostalgia in this.

items.name: Frontierland lettering
items.description: Orange park graphic with ornate Western lettering and a cartoon figure above it.
items.note: This is an old Frontierland poster. I love vintage Disney like this, especially Disney from the 2000s, like my childhood

discovery.via: Fantasy worlds made tangible through theme parks

items.name: Caterpillar smoke vowels
items.description: Pink and blue smoke letters drift among silhouetted Wonderland leaves.
items.note: This is a scene from Alice in Wonderland. It's a shot of the A, E, I, O, U from the Caterpillar. I love these niche scenes like that. When I like a popular movie like Alice in Wonderland, I always like the niche details

items.name: Giant woman in a miniature city
items.description: A woman in pink looms over miniature cars and buildings.
items.note: This is a giant woman walking through a city. I love this vibe. It reminds me of that. I don't know what it reminds me of: King Kong, space age. I don't know. I just love the giant woman as an aesthetic and a trope

items.name: Future Frontier
items.description: Orange and black starbursts, an orbital line and staggered turquoise lettering.
